💳 Payment Tracker — Upload to map receipts to bookings (by Booking Number)
💳 Payment Tracker PV
Not uploaded
💳 Payment Tracker CV
Not uploaded
💡 PV and CV share the exact same header structure and are parsed with the same logic. If both are uploaded, their rows are appended together (never merged/deduped by Booking Number — a booking can have receipts split across both files) and matched to bookings by Booking Number. Modes recognised: Bank Transfer (RTGS/Credit/Debit/eWallet), Cash/DD, Cheque, DO, PO, Trade-In. Receipt & Realized amounts are summed per mode across the combined dataset. Anything else is ignored. Re-upload each session.

🧬 File Merger
Append rows from other files into a main file. Map columns even with different names (XLOOKUP-style). Or do a key-based VLOOKUP merge.
1 Choose merge mode
📎 Append mode: Stacks rows from other files below the main file's rows. Use this when other files contain different records (different rows) that should be added. You decide which column from the other file goes into which column of the main file. Missing columns stay blank.

Step 1 — Upload Master
📂 Drop Master xlsx here or click to browse
Required sheet: Metal out · Optional: Enquiry, Booking, Retail
Detected dimensions
Step 2 — Pick filters (applied to all sheets)
Month
Dealership
PV / CV / EV
Pick All on any filter to include everything. The tool pre-filters the source data before download — your downloaded file contains only the rows matching your selections (no live filter in Excel). Pick different cuts and download multiple times if needed; the filename includes your filter values to keep them distinct.
Step 3 — Generate Monthly Working sheet
Output: original file + new "Monthly Working" tab. All figures are live formulas linked to Master data.
Process log
The output file will have these new sheets added:
📅 Monthly Working — Pre-filtered by your tool selections (Month · Dealership · PV/CV/EV) + Funnel · W1 Turnaround · W2 Delivery Scope · W3 OOS Reasons · W4 Finance · W5 Accessories · W6 Insurance · W7 Customer · W10 EW & RSA · W11 Deemed DSA
📈 Trend sheets (4): Enquiry Trend · Booking Trend · Retail Trend · Delivery Trend — each with Weekly · Day of Week · Fortnight · Monthly counts (by Dealership)
🏦 Tool Data (3): District Mapping · Finance Bank Summary · Insurance Company Summary
📊 Market Analysis (7): Market Summary · MoM Trend · Enquiry Analysis · Enq MoM Dealer · Booking Analysis · Bkg MoM Dealer · Dealer × Month
Everything is formula-linked — change a filter toggle and all numbers recalculate live from the Master data.

OEM Comparison Report — Metal Out
Upload two OEMs' Metal Out reports, edit the model-equivalence pairs, and get a side-by-side comparison of every Metal Out analysis (W1–W11) restricted to comparable vehicles.
Step 1 — Pick the two OEMs to compare
OEM A
vs
OEM B
Equivalence map is loaded from your comparison.xlsx (built-in). Pick any two — the comparable-vehicle pairs will appear below.
Step 2 — Confirm or edit the comparable-vehicle pairs
Pre-filled from your equivalence map. Edit any cell to change the model name as it appears in your Metal Out file. Use "-" or blank to skip a pair. After uploading both files (Step 3), each pair shows a match status against the uploaded data.
